title: Onsets
description: Per-service external and internal onsets and the incident onset t_onset, written by Anomara as onsets.json (03 §4.2). Onsets are in source time; consumers add the alignment offset of the recorded *_onset_source (and service).

t_onset_ns.description: Incident onset (02 §6.3): second-earliest non-null external_onset_ns, else the only one, else alert.t_alert_ns; clamped to [t_alert - 60 s, t_alert + 300 s].

method.description: How t_onset_ns was chosen: second_external (>= 2 external onsets, default rule), single_external (exactly 1), t_alert_fallback (none).

slo_breach_ns.description: First entry-service SLO breach: alert.t_alert_ns - alert.shift_ns if and only if alert.protocol = detected, else null (cross-artifact rule, checked in tests).

entry_services.description: Entry services: alert.detector.entry_services when set, else the shared entry rule on signal_cube.edges; sorted (UTF-8 byte order), may be empty.

per_service.description: One entry per service in case_manifest.services (cross-artifact rule, checked in tests), sorted by service.

items.title: OnsetsPerService
items.description: Onsets of one service; *_source and its onset are null together (enforced by the allOf below).

external_onset_ns.description: Earliest series onset of record (source time) over the service's klass-external series with robust_z above threshold or klass external/context series with silence above threshold; null if none.

external_onset_source.description: Source of the series that gave external_onset_ns (ties: smallest series_id); null if and only if external_onset_ns is null.

internal_onset_ns.description: Earliest series onset of record (source time) over the service's klass-internal series with robust_z or silence above threshold; null if none.

internal_onset_source.description: Source of the series that gave internal_onset_ns (ties: smallest series_id); null if and only if internal_onset_ns is null.

silent.description: True if any rps, workload or log_rate series of the service is silent, or at least silence.service_metric_share of its metric series are.
